---
name: Feature request / proposal
about: Propose an analyzer, UX, or adoption improvement (evidence-driven 1.3 backlog)

---

**Problem** What evidence or user friction motivates this?
**Existing workaround** Does current functionality already solve it?
**Proposed direction** (optional)
**External evidence** Links to adoption reports or related issues?

Note: 1.3 scope is evidence-driven (`docs/roadmap/1.3-evidence-backlog.md`); the first request does not auto-commit architecture.
